test_case_name: Open search field (desktop) and perform a search

intents.intent: Click the button labeled 'Search' to open the search field (desktop).
Type $name into the input field with placeholder 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?'.
Click the button with class 'btn-search' to perform the search (desktop).
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name.

And then check that the search field is cleared and no results are displayed.

test_case_name: Login as guest user with 'ENTRA' button

intents.intent: Type $email into the input field with placeholder 'E-mail'.
Type $password into the input field with placeholder 'Password'.
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest user.
And then check that the guest user is logged in and redirected to the appropriate page.

test_case_name: Login as guest user and enable 'Mantieni L'accesso' option

intents.intent: Type $email into the input field with placeholder 'E-mail'.
Type $password into the input field with placeholder 'Password'.
Click the checkbox labeled 'Mantieni L'accesso' to enable the keep me logged in option.
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest user.
And then check that the guest user is logged in and the session is persistent.
